div.div:
Blue box: outside participant. Green box: process. Grey open-ended box: stored data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Public username/profile
search is an alternative input to profile resolution; graph ranking and fallback details remain in sequence 26. Discovery output projects public profile fields and recommendation rank/session
metadata.
